---
title: "moth_model"
format: html
---

```{r}
# filter observed_on to 2015
rm(list = ls())
library(here) #localized file paths
library(tidyverse) #compendium of useful packages
library(janitor) #cleans data
library(rinat) #data interface for iNaturalist
library(sf) # for converting and using simple features in maps
library(rnaturalearth) #map data and functions
library(rnaturalearthdata) #map data
library(patchwork) # for stacking figures
library(sp)#For dealing with spatial data
library(adehabitatHR)# for home range estimation
library(readr)
library(lubridate)

obs_moth_clean <- read_csv(here("Semirelect_Underwing_RESEARCH_INAT.csv")) |> dplyr::select(latitude, longitude) |>drop_na()

moth_sf<-st_as_sf(obs_moth_clean, coords = c("longitude", "latitude"),crs = 4326)

moth_proj<-st_transform(moth_sf, 5070)
moth_points<-SpatialPoints(coords=st_coordinates(moth_proj), 
                                proj4string = CRS(st_crs(moth_proj)$proj4string))

kud<-kernelUD(moth_points, h="href")

kde_poly_moth_90<- getverticeshr(kud,percent = 90)
kde_poly_moth_50<- getverticeshr(kud,percent = 50)

north_am <- ne_countries(country = c("United States of America", "Canada"), 
                              scale = "medium", 
                              returnclass = "sf")
bbox <- st_bbox(moth_sf)

kde_sf_moth_90 <- st_as_sf(kde_poly_moth_90) |>
  st_transform(4326)
kde_sf_moth_50 <- st_as_sf(kde_poly_moth_50) |>
  st_transform(4326)

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = north_am, fill = "white", color = "gray30") +
  geom_sf(data = moth_sf, color="purple", alpha = 0.6,size = 1)  +
  geom_sf(data = kde_sf_moth_90, color="purple",size = 1)  +
  geom_sf(data = kde_sf_moth_50, color="purple",fill="purple", alpha=0.3, size = 1)  +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(bbox["xmin"], bbox["xmax"]),
           ylim = c(bbox["ymin"], bbox["ymax"])) +
  theme_void(base_size = 14)

```

```{r}
# yearly
obs_moth_yearly <- read_csv(here("Semirelect_Underwing_RESEARCH_INAT.csv")) |> 
  dplyr::select(observed_on, latitude, longitude) |>
  drop_na() |>
  mutate(year = year(as.Date(observed_on))) |>
  filter(year >= 2018)

#obs_moth_yearly |> count(year)

moth_sf_yearly <- st_as_sf(obs_moth_yearly, coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326) |>
  st_transform(5070)

moth_sp_yearly <- as_Spatial(moth_sf_yearly["year"])

kud_yearly <- kernelUD(moth_sp_yearly, h = "href")

kde_poly_yearly <- getverticeshr(kud_yearly, percent = 90)
kde_poly_yearly50 <- getverticeshr(kud_yearly, percent = 50)

kde_sf_yearly <- st_as_sf(kde_poly_yearly) |> 
  st_transform(4326) |>
  rename(year = id)
kde_sf_yearly50 <- st_as_sf(kde_poly_yearly50) |> 
  st_transform(4326) |>
  rename(year = id)

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = north_am, fill = "gray95", color = "white") +
  geom_sf(data = kde_sf_yearly, aes(fill = year), alpha = 0.4, color = "purple") +
  geom_sf(data = kde_sf_yearly50, aes(fill = year), color = "purple", alpha=0.5, size = 0.7) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(bbox["xmin"], bbox["xmax"]),
           ylim = c(bbox["ymin"], bbox["ymax"])) +
  facet_wrap(~year) + 
  scale_fill_viridis_d() +           
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.title = element_blank(),
        axis.text = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank())
```

```{r}
# seasonal
moth_seasonal <- obs_moth_yearly |>
  mutate(month = month(as.Date(observed_on)),
         season = case_when(
           month %in% c(3, 4, 5) ~ "Spring",
           month %in% c(6, 7, 8) ~ "Summer",
           month %in% c(9, 10, 11) ~ "Fall",
           TRUE ~ "Winter"
         )) |>
  mutate(season = factor(season, levels = c("Summer", "Fall")))

moth_sp_season <- as_Spatial(st_as_sf(moth_seasonal, coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326) |> 
                    st_transform(5070))["season"]

# FALL 2021 -- only 2 obs
kud_season <- kernelUD(moth_sp_season, h = "href")
kde_sf_season <- st_as_sf(getverticeshr(kud_season, percent = 90)) |> 
  st_transform(4326) |> 
  rename(season = id)
kde_sf_season50 <- st_as_sf(getverticeshr(kud_season, percent = 50)) |> 
  st_transform(4326) |> 
  rename(season = id)

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = north_am, fill = "gray95", color = "white") +
  geom_sf(data = kde_sf_season, aes(fill = season), alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_sf(data = kde_sf_season50, aes(fill = season), alpha = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~season) +
    coord_sf(xlim = c(bbox["xmin"], bbox["xmax"]),
           ylim = c(bbox["ymin"], bbox["ymax"]))  +
  theme_void()
```

```{r}
# seasonal by year
moth_seasonal_yearly <- moth_seasonal |>
  mutate(year_season = paste(season, year, sep = " ")) |>
  # only 3 obs made in fall 2021; kernelUD requires at least 5
  filter(year_season != "Fall 2021")

moth_sp_seasonal_yearly <- as_Spatial(st_as_sf(moth_seasonal_yearly, coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326) |> 
                    st_transform(5070))["year_season"]

kud_seasonal_yearly <- kernelUD(moth_sp_seasonal_yearly, h = "href", extent=2)
kde_sf_seasonal_yearly <- st_as_sf(getverticeshr(kud_seasonal_yearly, percent = 90)) |> 
  st_transform(4326) |> 
  rename(year_season = id)
kde_sf_seasonal_yearly50 <- st_as_sf(getverticeshr(kud_seasonal_yearly, percent = 50)) |> 
  st_transform(4326) |> 
  rename(year_season = id)

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = north_am, fill = "gray95", color = "white") +
  geom_sf(data = kde_sf_seasonal_yearly, aes(fill = year_season), alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_sf(data = kde_sf_seasonal_yearly50, aes(fill = year_season), alpha = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~year_season) +
    coord_sf(xlim = c(bbox["xmin"], bbox["xmax"]),
           ylim = c(bbox["ymin"], bbox["ymax"]))  +
  theme_void()
```
